preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The grid dimensions H and W must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of particles N must be between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y[i] <= H and 1 <= x[i] <= W for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each particle's position (y[i], x[i]) must be within the grid boundaries.
The absolute value of each particle's value must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum value of V followed by the signs of the particles.

postconditions.expression: len(signs) == N and all(sign in {1, -1} for sign in signs)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N signs, each being either 1 or -1.
